strategy_vs_analysis.reason: The target SEG2 is chosen by comparing segment sizes and purchase intent (17.5M adults at 41% vs SEG1 at 1.3M at 72%), tied to the 1,500-point-of-sale and 2% share goals. Channels mirror the market distribution figures (68/17/9/6%). The main gap is pricing, which the plan openly leaves undecided because competitor prices are unknown, so it is explained rather than unsupported.

campaign_vs_strategy.reason: Messages are addressed to weekly sport practitioners and reflect the 15 g protein and clean-ingredient value proposition across the five strategy channels. One minor gap: the Instagram and gyms messages are close to generic, and the Instagram message does not explicitly say "sport" beyond the headline, but nothing contradicts the strategy.
